get_daily_forecast.description: Get the day-by-day forecast for a location, with highs and lows, rain and snow totals, wind, UV, and sunrise and sunset times. Tomorrow.io serves 5 days on the free plan and more on paid ones.
get_daily_forecast.display_str_template: Get the Tomorrow.io daily forecast for '{0}'.

location.name: Boston, Suffolk County, Massachusetts, United States

get_daily_forecast.name: get_daily_forecast

parameters.description: Where to look up. Accepts 'latitude,longitude' ('42.3478,-71.0466'), a city name ('new york'), a US zip code with country ('10001 US'), or a UK postcode ('SW1').
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Unit system for the figures. Metric gives Celsius, m/s, and millimetres; imperial gives Fahrenheit, mph, and inches. Defaults to Tomorrow.io's own default, which is metric.
parameters.name: units

days.description: One entry per forecast day, earliest first.

date.description: Start of the forecast day, ISO 8601 UTC.

moon_phase.description: Tomorrow.io's moon phase code for the day, 0 (new moon) through 7 (waning crescent).

precipitation_probability_avg.description: Average chance of precipitation across the day, percent.

rain_accumulation_sum.description: Total rain for the day, in mm or inches.

snow_accumulation_sum.description: Total snow for the day, in mm or inches.

uv_health_concern_max.description: Highest UV risk band reached: 0 low to 4 extreme.

uv_index_max.description: Highest UV index reached during the day.

weather_code.description: Tomorrow.io condition code, e.g. 1000 for clear or 4001 for rain. Stable and language-independent, so branch on this rather than on the text.

weather_code_text.description: The condition in words, e.g. 'Light Rain', resolved from the code. Null if Tomorrow.io returns a code that is not in its published list.

name.description: Resolved place name. Null when the request gave coordinates rather than a name.

type.description: What kind of place matched, e.g. administrative or postal. Null when the request gave coordinates.

get_hourly_forecast.description: Get the hour-by-hour forecast for a location, with the same readings as the realtime action for each upcoming hour.
get_hourly_forecast.display_str_template: Get the Tomorrow.io hourly forecast for '{0}'.

location.name: Boston, Suffolk County, Massachusetts, United States

get_hourly_forecast.name: get_hourly_forecast

parameters.description: Where to look up. Accepts 'latitude,longitude' ('42.3478,-71.0466'), a city name ('new york'), a US zip code with country ('10001 US'), or a UK postcode ('SW1').
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: How many hours to return, 1 to 120, starting from the current hour. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: hours

parameters.description: Unit system for the figures. Metric gives Celsius, m/s, and millimetres; imperial gives Fahrenheit, mph, and inches. Defaults to Tomorrow.io's own default, which is metric.
parameters.name: units

hours.description: One entry per hour, earliest first.

cloud_base.description: Height of the lowest cloud layer's base, in km or miles. Null when there is no cloud.

cloud_ceiling.description: Height of the lowest broken or overcast layer, in km or miles. Null when the sky is clearer than that.

dew_point.description: Dew point, same unit as temperature.

freezing_rain_intensity.description: Freezing rain rate, in mm/hr or in/hr depending on units.

pressure_surface_level.description: Surface pressure, in hPa or inHg depending on units.

rain_intensity.description: Rain rate, in mm/hr or in/hr depending on units.

sleet_intensity.description: Sleet rate, in mm/hr or in/hr depending on units.

snow_intensity.description: Snow rate, in mm/hr or in/hr depending on units.

temperature.description: Temperature, in °C or °F depending on units.

temperature_apparent.description: What the temperature feels like, same unit as temperature.

time.description: Start of the hour, ISO 8601 UTC.

uv_health_concern.description: UV risk band derived from the index: 0 low, 1 moderate, 2 high, 3 very high, 4 extreme.

visibility.description: Visibility, in km or miles depending on units.

weather_code.description: Tomorrow.io condition code, e.g. 1000 for clear or 4001 for rain. Stable and language-independent, so branch on this rather than on the text.

weather_code_text.description: The condition in words, e.g. 'Light Rain', resolved from the code. Null if Tomorrow.io returns a code that is not in its published list.

wind_direction.description: Wind direction in degrees, 0-360, measured clockwise from north.

wind_gust.description: Wind gust speed, in m/s or mph depending on units.

wind_speed.description: Wind speed, in m/s or mph depending on units.

name.description: Resolved place name. Null when the request gave coordinates rather than a name.

type.description: What kind of place matched, e.g. administrative or postal. Null when the request gave coordinates.
